title: [Nichibei] Archiving a Lesson Allocation Does Not Spuriously Create a CM Chatter Post or Revert a Published Lesson to Draft
description: AC-1 / AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case: directly verifying the spec's named concern. Archiving is structurally incapable of reaching the CancelLessonBooking platform event that both the Chatter post and Draft-revert depend on.
preconditions:
Published Lesson X (auto-published via booking) has exactly 1 Student Session, Student A, booked via the self-service app. No existing Chatter post exists on Lesson X under topic 予約授業のキャンセル
CM1 is assigned to Lesson X's Location
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff confirms Lesson X's status = Published, 1 Student Session, 0 Chatter posts"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived (NOT via the app's self-cancel action)"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks Lesson X's status in Salesforce"
4. "HQ or CM Staff checks Lesson X's Chatter/Activity tab"
steps_result:
1. "Baseline confirmed"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated; Student A's Student Session becomes Is_Archived__c = TRUE via formula - hidden, but not deleted"
3. "Lesson X remains Published - no Draft-revert occurred, since archiving never publishes the CancelLessonBooking platform event this logic depends on"
4. "No new Chatter post was created - still 0 posts under topic 予約授業のキャンセル"
steps_data:
1. "Published; count = 1; 0 posts"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp; Student Session record still exists"
3. "Lesson X Status = Published, unchanged"
4. "0 posts, unchanged"

title: [Nichibei] Unarchive Does Not Resend a Cancellation Notification or Recreate a Booking
description: AC-3 (parity) - Regression - control case: directly verifying the spec's named concern ("unarchive must not silently recreate a booking or resend a notification").
preconditions: Following directly from the case above: Lesson X's Lesson Allocation for Student A is archived; Lesson X remains Published with 0 Chatter posts
steps_actions:
1. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
2. "HQ or CM Staff checks Lesson X's Chatter/Activity tab"
3. "HQ or CM Staff checks whether a second Student Session was created for Student A on Lesson X"
4. "HQ or CM Staff checks Lesson X's status"
steps_result:
1. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again; Student A's Student Session returns to Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "No new Chatter post was created by the restore - still 0 posts"
3. "Exactly one Student Session exists - the same original record, not a newly 'recreated' booking"
4. "Lesson X remains Published, unaffected by the restore"
steps_data:
1. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
2. "0 posts, unchanged"
3. "Expect: 1 Student Session, same Id as before archive"
4. "Lesson X Status = Published, unchanged"

title: [Nichibei] CM Chatter Post's Student Name Link Still Resolves Correctly After the Referenced LA Later Archives
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression - control case: confirms the historical-record-access principle holds for this permalink, built before the archive and never re-queried.
preconditions:
Student A previously self-cancelled a different booking, creating a CM Chatter post whose [Student Name] token links to Student A's Lesson Allocation (LA-A)
LA-A has since archived (Archived_At__c populated), unrelated to the cancellation itself
steps_actions:
1. "CM1 opens the existing Chatter post and clicks the Student Name link"
2. "CM1 confirms the record is viewable, not an error/broken-link page"
steps_result:
1. "The link still navigates to LA-A's record, now showing it as archived (Archived_At__c populated)"
2. "LA-A's detail page loads normally, consistent with AC-5's 'archived records remain reachable by direct record Id' principle"
steps_data:
1. "LA-A Archived_At__c = populated"
2. "Permalink is a raw Id reference with no archive-filtered query"
